text: dsh-turn-chime 是面向 DSH 网页端的对话完成提示插件。它在宿主侧监听用户消息、轮次结束原因和 agent 空闲状态，只对正常完成的用户任务发送一次事件，再由浏览器通过 SSE 接收并用 Web Audio 合成提示音。用户可以在设置面板启停提示、选择音色、调节音量、过滤子代理会话，并开启 Windows 任务栏数字角标。适合希望及时知道 DSH 任务何时正常结束的网页端用户。配置保存在浏览器本地，无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-turn-chime alerts DSH web users when tasks finish normally. The host checks turn events and sends SSE; it makes chimes with Web Audio. Settings control tone, volume, subagent filtering, and a Windows taskbar badge. Preferences stay in browser storage. No key or external service is needed.
希望 DSH 的任务正常跑完时能自动提醒我。
能不能给网页端的 DSH 加个可调音量的完成提示？
Play an alert when my DSH task completes normally in the browser.
dsh-turn-chime 的功能「任务完成提示音」：用户发起的轮次正常结束且 agent 转为空闲时，宿主通过 SSE 通知浏览器，由 Web Audio 播放可选音色；设置面板可启停提示、调节音量并预览声音。

dsh-turn-chime README · dsh-turn-chime：[](https://dsh.market/)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Plays a chime when a conversation task **actually finishes**. The decision is made on the host side, the sound is emitted in the client, and the tone is synthesized on the fly with Web Audio — no audio files involved.
dsh-turn-chime README · What it solves：DeepSeek Harness's `api-session/status` only tells you whether the agent is busy right now. Using it directly as a completion signal runs into two problems:

dsh-turn-chime README · What it solves：- **It can't tell "finished" from "interrupted".** When the user hits stop, a run exits with an error, or a hook blocks it, the status flips back to idle all the same.
- **A single task can consist of multiple drivers.** Subagents feeding results back, goal rounds continuing the run — every driver that stops flips idle once, so one stretch of work chimes several times.
dsh-turn-chime README · What it solves：This plugin moves the decision to the host side, so it chimes exactly once, and only when a user-initiated task finishes normally.

dsh-turn-chime README · Install：Put the repository in any directory, then:

```powershell
node install.mjs                  # install into %DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop
node install.mjs web              # install into the named profile (multiple allowed)
node install.mjs X:\path\to\profile
```

dsh-turn-chime README · Install：The script does three things: writes a `file:` dependency into the profile's `package.json`, adds the plugin name to `dsh.profile.bundles`, and creates a junction under `node_modules/<plugin>` pointing at this repository (so source edits take effect immediately, with no copy to re-sync).

**DSH must be restarted after installing** — the client module manifest is generated at startup, so the plugin won't load without a restart.
dsh-turn-chime README · Install：To uninstall: remove that line from `dsh.profile.bundles`, then delete `node_modules/dsh-turn-chime`.

dsh-turn-chime README · Usage：Settings → **Chime**:

| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| Enable chime | Master switch |
| Voice | Crisp ding / Bell / Short pluck / Short beep / Water drop / Xylophone / Retro two-tone / Soft bass / Muted |
| Volume | 0–100%, previews automatically when you release the slider |
| Ignore subagent sessions | On by default. A subagent finishing doesn't count as "the thing the user is waiting for" |
| Event channel | Shows whether SSE is connected and how many times it has chimed so far |
dsh-turn-chime README · Usage：The configuration is stored in the browser's `localStorage` (`dsh-turn-chime:config:v1`).

dsh-turn-chime README · When it fires：One user message chimes once: the `pending` flag is consumed on the first ring, so automatic continuation of the same task doesn't ring again.

The verdict is pushed to the client over SSE at `/dsh-turn-chime/events`.

dsh-turn-chime README · Troubleshooting：| What you see in the log | Meaning |
|---|---|
| No `client-ready` | The client plugin didn't load; restart DSH |
| `sse:false` | The browser has no `EventSource`, so completion events don't arrive |
| `client-ready` but no `sse-open` | SSE never connected; check the event channel in the settings panel |
| Only `skip-turn-end` | That turn's reason wasn't `completed` |
| No `chime` line at all | The host didn't pass its check: that message wasn't sent by the user |
| `play ok:false` | The voice is "Muted", or the audio context is suspended by policy |

dsh-turn-chime README · Troubleshooting：Three routes from the same source:

- `GET  /dsh-turn-chime/events` — SSE completion event stream
- `GET  /dsh-turn-chime/log` — reads back the last 120 lines
- `POST /dsh-turn-chime/clear` — clears the log

Debug entry points in the browser console:

```js
__dshTurnChime.play('chime', 0.6)  // preview manually
__dshTurnChime.status()            // { connected, chimes, config }
__dshTurnChime.onChime('x')        // simulate a completion event → should chime once
```

dsh-turn-chime README · Why it's split this way：**Sound can only come from the renderer process.** Playing audio in the host means either spawning a PowerShell/player process (hundreds of milliseconds of cold start, plus process reaping to manage), or using Electron's `shell.beep()` (no choice of tone). Web Audio is zero-dependency, zero-latency, cross-platform, and can synthesize tones on the fly.

dsh-turn-chime README · Why it's split this way：**The decision can only live in the host.** The `api-session/status` the client receives is a boolean, so it can't show whether this turn ended normally or someone pressed stop; the `turn/end` reason and the `user/message` source exist only on the host event bus.

dsh-turn-chime README · Files：| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Host: completion decision + the four routes `/dsh-turn-chime/{events,diag,log,clear}` |
| `lib/client.js` | Client: SSE subscription, Web Audio synthesis, settings panel, diagnostics reporting |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch; a single insert line activates the plugin |
| `install.mjs` | Idempotent install script |
| `test/test-logic.mjs` | Decision-logic tests (replays event sequences against a fake ctx) |

dsh-turn-chime README · Tests：```powershell
node test/test-logic.mjs   # or npm test
```

Covers six scenarios: normal finish → chime; user interrupt → silent; time-context injection only → silent; one message with two drivers → chime once; error → silent; interrupt followed by a new message that finishes → chime.

dsh-turn-chime README · Known limitations：- The chime only plays in the browser renderer process, so there is no sound while DSH is fully closed.
- The decision depends on DSH internal events (`session/event`, `agent/status`). If their shape changes in a major DSH upgrade, `lib/index.js` needs a matching update.
- It only chimes on `reason.kind === "completed"`; a turn that errors out is silent. To make errors ring as well (with a different sound), change `CHIME_REASON` in `lib/index.js`.

dsh-turn-chime README · dsh-turn-chime：[](https://dsh.market/)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

对话任务**真正跑完**时播放一声提示音。判定在宿主侧、发声在客户端，音色用 Web Audio 现场合成，不带任何音频文件。

dsh-turn-chime README · 它解决什么：DeepSeek Harness 的 `api-session/status` 只告诉你「agent 现在忙不忙」。直接拿它当完成信号会踩两个坑：

- **分不出「跑完」和「被中断」**。用户按下停止、报错退出、被 hook 拦下，状态同样会翻回 idle。
- **一个任务可能由多个 driver 组成**。子代理回灌结果、goal 轮次续跑，每个 driver 停下都会翻一次 idle，于是一段任务响好几次。

这个插件把判定挪到宿主侧，只有「用户发起的任务正常跑完」才响一次。

dsh-turn-chime README · 安装：把仓库放在任意目录，然后：

```powershell
node install.mjs                  # 装进 %DSH_HOME%\profiles\desktop
node install.mjs web              # 装进指定 profile（可给多个）
node install.mjs X:\path\to\profile
```

脚本做三件事：往 profile 的 `package.json` 写 `file:` 依赖、往 `dsh.profile.bundles` 加插件名、在 `node_modules/<插件>` 建一个指向本仓库的 junction（所以改源码立即生效，不用再同步副本）。

**装完必须重启 DSH** —— 客户端模块清单在启动时生成，不重启不会加载。

卸载：从 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉这一行，再删掉 `node_modules/dsh-turn-chime`。

dsh-turn-chime README · 使用：设置 → **提示音**：

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 启用提示音 | 总开关 |
| 音色 | 清脆叮声 / 钟声 / 短促清音 / 短促提示 / 水滴 / 木琴 / 复古双音 / 柔和低音 / 静音 |
| 音量 | 0–100%，拖完自动试听 |
| 忽略子代理会话 | 默认开。子代理跑完不算「用户等的那件事」 |
| 事件通道 | 显示 SSE 是否连着，以及本次已响几次 |

配置存在浏览器 `localStorage`（`dsh-turn-chime:config:v1`）。

dsh-turn-chime README · 触发时机：三个条件同时满足才响：

1. `session/event` 的 `user/message`，且 `source.kind === "user"` —— 用户真的发过一条消息（time-context 注入、子代理回灌、hook 注入都不算）；
2. `session/event` 的 `turn/end`，且 `reason.kind === "completed"` —— 正常跑完。被中断（`aborted`）、报错（`error`）、被 hook 拦下（`blocked`）、撞上 `max-tokens` 都不响；
3. `agent/status` 翻到 `idle` —— 一个 driver 彻底停下。

一次用户消息只响一次：`pending` 标记在第一次响铃时消费掉，之后同一任务的自动续跑不再重复响。

判定结果经 SSE `/dsh-turn-chime/events` 推给客户端。

dsh-turn-chime README · 排查：| 日志里看到什么 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 没有 `client-ready` | 客户端插件没加载，重启 DSH |
| `sse:false` | 浏览器没有 `EventSource`，收不到完成事件 |
| 有 `client-ready` 但没有 `sse-open` | SSE 没连上，看设置面板的事件通道 |
| 只有 `skip-turn-end` | 那次结束的 reason 不是 `completed` |
| 完全没有 `chime` 行 | 宿主没判定通过：那条消息不是用户发的 |
| `play ok:false` | 音色是「静音」，或音频上下文被策略挂起 |

三条同源路由：

- `GET  /dsh-turn-chime/events` —— SSE 完成事件流
- `GET  /dsh-turn-chime/log` —— 读回最近 120 行
- `POST /dsh-turn-chime/clear` —— 清空日志

浏览器控制台里的调试入口：

dsh-turn-chime README · 排查：```js
__dshTurnChime.play('chime', 0.6)  // 手动试听
__dshTurnChime.status()            // { connected, chimes, config }
__dshTurnChime.onChime('x')        // 模拟一次完成事件 → 应当响一声
```

dsh-turn-chime README · 为什么这么分：**发声只能在渲染进程。** 宿主里播声音要么 spawn 一个 PowerShell/播放器进程（冷启动几百毫秒，还要管进程回收），要么用 Electron 的 `shell.beep()`（音色不可选）。Web Audio 零依赖、零延迟、跨平台，音色还能现场合成。

**判定只能在宿主。** 客户端拿到的 `api-session/status` 是个布尔值，看不出这次结束是正常跑完还是被按了停止；`turn/end` 的 reason 和 `user/message` 的来源都只存在于宿主事件总线里。

dsh-turn-chime README · 文件：| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主：完成判定 + `/dsh-turn-chime/{events,diag,log,clear}` 四条路由 |
| `lib/client.js` | 客户端：SSE 订阅、Web Audio 合成、设置面板、诊断上报 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 补丁，一条 insert 行激活插件 |
| `install.mjs` | 幂等安装脚本 |
| `test/test-logic.mjs` | 判定逻辑测试（假 ctx 回放事件序列） |

dsh-turn-chime README · 测试：```powershell
node test/test-logic.mjs   # 或 npm test
```

覆盖六个场景：正常跑完→响、用户中断→不响、只有 time-context 注入→不响、一次消息两个 driver→只响一次、报错→不响、中断后再发消息跑完→响。

dsh-turn-chime README · 已知限制：- 提示音只在浏览器渲染进程里响，DSH 完全关闭时不会有声音。
- 判定依赖 DSH 的内部事件（`session/event`、`agent/status`）。DSH 大版本升级后如果事件形状变了，`lib/index.js` 需要同步调整。
- 只在 `reason.kind === "completed"` 时响，出错的结束是静音的。想让出错也响（换一种声音），改 `lib/index.js` 里的 `CHIME_REASON`。
